description: Conservative, deliberately unverified defaults used when no platform-specific profile exists. Every numeric limit here is a made-up-safe placeholder, not a real platform's documented limit - lib/omes/py/content/validation.py treats every field lacking "verified": true as advisory (a warning, never a publish-blocking error) for exactly this reason. An operator adding a new platform should copy this file, then replace each field's value and set "verified": true only after confirming it against that platform's own current documentation - never carry this file's numbers forward as if they were verified.
